title: Commit workspace imports transactionally
description: Apply an explicitly confirmed valid ImportPlan as one atomic workspace replacement so any failure rolls back and preserves the prior workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: Commit accepts only the exact validated candidate/plan identity explicitly confirmed by the user
All registered records and assets commit within an atomic replacement strategy
Any injected or real failure leaves pre-import durable state byte/logically equivalent
Success reports committed counts/migrations and failure reports rollback without partial-success language
Cancellation before commit and stale-plan detection perform no mutation

steps.details: Hash or identify the validated candidate and require the confirmed ImportPlan to match exact bytes/schema/findings before commit.
Stage or transact all registered stores/assets and publish only after every write/reference check succeeds; abort on any error.
Announce success with exact counts/migrations or failure with rollback confirmation and safe retry/cancel actions.
Fail at representative record/asset/commit stages and compare complete pre/post durable snapshots, then test stale plans and successful commit.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; use the established IndexedDB transaction/staging seam and focused failure injection.
Prefer one IndexedDB version/store transaction where feasible; otherwise use a proven staging-and-swap protocol with recovery marker.
Never describe a partial import as successful recovery.
